name: Starz Defence
dev: LK Yazilim Veri ve Medya Limited Sirketi

ios.desc:
Are you ready to journey through the depths of space? Starz Defence challenges you to protect your spaceship against endless waves of enemy forces and massive bosses in this action-packed space shooter game.

Game Features:

-Intense Space Battles: Face increasingly difficult waves of enemies, each bringing new challenges. Utilize your skills and tactics to survive and advance.

-Epic Boss Fights: Prepare for monumental battles against gigantic bosses that will test your strategy and reflexes.

-Collect Resources: Defeat enemies and bosses to earn gold. Gather rare Rainbow Gems to unlock special upgrades or convert them into gold for even more enhancements.

-Unlock New Planets: Progress through the game to discover and defend new planets, each with unique backgrounds and increasing challenges.

-Bonus Rewards: Collect time-based bonuses to boost your resources and watch ads to earn extra Rainbow Gems.

-Stunning Graphics and Soundtracks: Immerse yourself in captivating visuals and epic soundtracks that enhance your space combat experience.

Will you rise to become the hero the galaxy needs?

Prepare your defenses, upgrade your spaceship, and embark on an epic journey through the stars. Download Starz Defence now and take on the mission to save the universe!
